mapper.insert: INSERT INTO improvement_measure(trouble_ticket_id, name, executor, executor_id, implementation_time, todo, todo_id, status, create_man_id, create_man) VALUES (#{troubleTicketId}, #{name}, #{executor}, #{executorId}, #{implementationTime}, #{todo}, #{todoId}, #{status}, #{createManId}, #{createMan})
mapper.select: SELECT id, name, executor, implementation_time, todo, status, create_man, modify_date FROM improvement_measure WHERE trouble_ticket_id = #{troubleTicketId} AND is_deleted = false

SELECT id, trouble_ticket_id, name, executor, executor_id, implementation_time, todo, todo_id, status, is_deleted, create_man_id, create_man, create_date, modify_man_id, modify_man, modify_date FROM improvement_measure WHERE id = #{id}
